# Asia Pacific Language School (APLS)

> Asia Pacific Language School is an independent nonprofit, accredited private school in Bellevue, Washington, offering Chinese and Japanese language education from preschool through high school.

APLS has served Eastside families since 1995. The school is located at 14042 NE 8th Street, 1st Floor, Bellevue, WA 98007.

## Programs

- [All programs](https://www.apls.org/programs.html): Program finder for ages 2.5 through high school.
- [Immersion preschool](https://www.apls.org/preschool.html): Chinese and Japanese immersion for ages 2.5-6.
- [Kindergarten and 1st grade](https://www.apls.org/kindergarten.html): Dual-language elementary education.
- [After-school classes](https://www.apls.org/after-school.html): Weekday Chinese and Japanese classes.
- [Summer camp](https://www.apls.org/summer-camp.html): Weekly language and culture camps.
- [Saturday school](https://www.apls.org/saturday-school.html): Weekend Chinese and Japanese language classes.
- [AP preparation](https://www.apls.org/ap-prep.html): AP Chinese and AP Japanese preparation for older students.
